edits.new: and the baseline and frozen flags of `measure_snapshot` move in rwb_reporting. This service serves the facts of `snapshot(page)` for a business date whose ACE batches are complete; rwb-reporting publishes the baseline and freezes it. The frozen baseline is not written back to this service: no value, flag or row of it is written here (BR13; GAP-1503).
